piece.title: String Quartet No.12 in F major, Op.96 (“American”)
piece.why: The famous viola opening: the theme starts in the viola under violin tremolo, moves to Violin I, then trades between cello and Violin I and cascades up through all four parts.

roster.label: Quartet that lost its viola: 2 violins, cello, + a clarinet
